goal: Inventory the assets/ tree: capture a file.list of assets/, then run /usr/bin/find over assets for regular files and pipe its captured stdout into /usr/bin/sort so the manifest is deterministic, and write the sorted listing to out/manifest.txt. Return a record { entries: <the file.list result>, manifest: <sorted stdout> }.
notes: file.list returns [{ name, stat: { path, kind, bytes, mode, device, inode } }].
Run /usr/bin/find with cwd: workspace and a relative root so the manifest stays workspace-relative.
